content: General Manfred was unable to retake Lifebone.

content: If they dare approach the Shard...

raw: [name="Theresis"]My sword will render the judgment that I promised.
speaker: Theresis
content: My sword will render the judgment that I promised.

content: She finally averts her gaze from the Shard. She no longer sees the figure.

content: Theresa casts her eyes toward the shadow of the airship, toward the land that she has seen so many times.

content: Sorrow and despair continues to spread. Has anything changed from when she left Kazdel?

content: I sense it, Theresa. The 'King' continues to pursue us.

speaker: Theresa
content: They've never given up easily.

speaker: Shadow
content: ...Hah.

content: But an intangible wave strikes, space and time roiling around the airship.

content: The spark will burn for us until there is nothing left to burn.

content: Let's see how far they can go.

content: Did Hoederer seriously convince Bonesy here to help us? For real?

content: Ask him? He can barely speak right now.

content: Then trust him.

content: Ugh. Hope he didn't mess up the steps.

options: Does he intend to ram that piece of 'Originium' with the airship?

content: She means that we need to deal with the airship before we kill Theresis.

speaker: W
content: Am I right, old hag?

content: Yes.

speaker: W
content: Then we'll take it down.

speaker: W
content: ...Huh?

content: I can feel it...

content: She... Theresa is there, isn't she?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...Yes.

content: We must be ready to—

content: Hah.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...If necessary.

speaker: W
content: Clap clap.

speaker: W
content: I thought you two got along.

content: Even Theresa.

speaker: W
content: Hmph.

content: I'm not like you, though.

content: I'll save her from the myriad souls and end it all. If you won't do it, I will.

speaker: W
content: Just wait and see.

speaker: W
content: There isn't gonna be another betrayal.

content: Hang on!

content: I'll intercept any stray projectiles.

content: Mon3tr.

content: (Joyful braying)
